Walkthrough

The SPV module now exposes `HeaderLookup` and `SpvRuntime::header_hash_at`. The method documents separate outcomes for a stored header, an absent height, and an unreadable store or stopped client. **Changes: Public header lookup API** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Expose the header lookup API**
`packages/rs-platform-wallet/src/wallet/asset_lock/sync/locate.rs`, `packages/rs-platform-wallet/src/spv/runtime.rs`, `packages/rs-platform-wallet/src/spv/mod.rs`|`HeaderLookup` is public and re-exported from `spv`. `SpvRuntime::header_hash_at` is public and documents the `Found`, `Absent`, and `Unreadable` outcomes.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~8 minutes **Change:** Bug fix
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to e5791

The public header lookup API is ready to merge. An external compile test would help protect its visibility against future regressions.
